issue.title: Retire monitor_continuation_records
issue.description: New monitor starts persist versioned continuation records, frozen outcome policy, checkpoints, and durable delivery/adoption state for production continuation routing.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Ancestry, evidence, delivery, completion, budget recovery, and representative task-evaluation gates pass on the production route and known callers have migrated from the legacy writer/launcher branch.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: New monitor starts use the legacy monitor writer and launcher path without publishing versioned continuation records; already-written v1 records remain readable with their stored semantics.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: New monitor starts persist versioned continuation records, frozen outcome policy, checkpoints, and durable delivery/adoption state for production continuation routing.

payload.entry: Authorized by epic sase-1jc retire-all-flags plan (phase monitor-records): all-enabled behavior was already the default and is now unconditional. Removed FeatureFlag.monitor_continuation_records enum member and registry definition, new-start flag selection (monitor_continuation_records_enabled), the legacy writer/start branch in monitor start flow/launch, the versioned-controls rejection helper, and the capture env fallback; new starts always persist records_v1 protocol, frozen policy, checkpoints and delivery state. Retained persisted protocol/sentinel dispatch (monitor_continuation_records_enabled_for_meta) for settlement, follow-up, resume and recovery of existing/legacy monitors. Regenerated sase.schema.json; updated docs/monitors.md and docs/configuration.md. Verified: tests/monitor + tests/continuation focused suites pass (554 passed; reworked rollout tests now prove unconditional v1 starts and legacy-protocol retention without flag overrides). The single failure in test_monitor_proc_facade (incident_save_chat_history_crash) reproduces identically on the clean base tree.
